text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to kick off a pricing A/B experiment next Tue 09:00 PT for price-sheet v3. Main asks: we must protect grandfathered contracts, add surge safeguards to avoid invoice spikes, and confirm A/B cohort exclusions. Who can own surge protections + backfill?

aj (Billing): I can own surge protections + backfill. Plan: auto-fallthrough to legacy rate for any account marked as grandfathered and temporarily throttle pricing changes if daily invoice delta > threshold. Need the grandfathered list in billing_account_id form by EOD. :shield:

lena (Sales Ops): sending a CSV to the shared drive now. Quick question — which key do you want us to use to match records, `external_customer_id` or `billing_account_id`?

aj (Billing): Use `billing_account_id`. That's what backfill and invoice runner expect. I'll post a small mapping script momentarily.

sam (Engineering): FYI the nightly billing export currently only contains `external_customer_id`. I can add `billing_account_id` to the export and backfill pipeline; deploy window is tomorrow 02:00 PT. No hot path otherwise.

rajesh (Product): Can we keep enterprise / reserved customers out of the A/B? Suggest canary at 5% of eligible PAYG customers. Also add automatic rollback if invoice impact > $1,000/day or >5% uplift in error tickets.

kevin (Revenue Ops): Agree to exclude reserved and enterprise. Also call out vendor pass-throughs (accelerator credits, cloud provider GPU line items) — they can distort the per-token economics. We'll add a filter to ignore known vendor pass-through SKUs for the experiment metrics.

nora (Support): Heads-up: expect some invoice reopen requests. I'll prepare a canned response: "We're investigating a temporary pricing experiment; if your charges look off we'll reconcile and make adjustments." Will create a macro.

aj (Billing): Action checklist:
• sam: add `billing_account_id` to nightly export and deploy (tomorrow 02:00 PT).
• maria: upload final grandfathered list (billing_account_id) + contract cutoff dates.
• aj: implement surge-protection rule and dry-run backfill on staging.
• kevin: add vendor-SKU filters and daily delta alerts.
• lena: tag cohorts and exclude enterprise in rollout config.

I'll open a PR: `tools/billing/surge_guard.py` and a runbook `runbooks/billing/pricing-experiment-backfill.md`.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled — sam will deploy `billing-export` change tomorrow 2029-04-09 02:00 PT. Status: scheduled.

maria: Uploaded grandfathered list to GDrive: https://drive.internal/redwood/finance/grandfathered_v3.csv — includes `billing_account_id` and `contract_end_date`. Also added a short backfill runbook (link in the sheet).

aj (Billing): I'll run a staging dry-run of the backfill Thu 03:00 PT. Command for the run: `python tools/billing/usage_reconcile.py --mode dry-run --since 2029-03-01 --filter grandfathered` — will post logs to the PR.

sam (Engineering): Deploying export change now. If anyone needs rollback, ping me in this thread. I have a hotfix branch ready: `billing-export/remove-billing-id`

kevin (Revenue Ops): I'll create two alerts: daily invoice delta > $500 and cohort delta > 10%. If either triggers, ops-notifications goes to `#oncall-revops` and open a rapid review doc.

rajesh (Product): One more: DS will need matched pre/post cohorts and full raw usage token breakdown per account. lena please tag cohorts in the A/B JSON config and add a note for DS.

lena (Sales Ops): Will tag cohorts and upload `ab_cohorts_v3.json` by EOD.

maria: Thanks everyone. If you see unexpected vendor charge anomalies or large invoice drift during dry-run, DM me immediately — we'll pause the experiment. :eyes:

aj (Billing): TL;DR: I will own surge guard + backfill. Expect PR + staging dry-run logs by Thu.

nora (Support): I'll standby with the macro and a short KB article for account teams.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook `runbooks/billing/pricing-experiment-backfill.md` created by aj — link: https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/pricing-experiment-backfill

maria: closing the loop — final go/no-go sync tomorrow 08:00 PT in this thread. Please post blockers before then. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
